title: About the GNL
lead: A team league with solo matches, created by the Gym Discord community to give new and veteran players a competitive — and fun — place to compete.

children.text: The GNL is built for players between the grass/beginner leagues and roughly 1700–1800 MMR — anyone who wants organised, competitive games without stepping into the pro scene. If you're friendly, active in game and on Discord, there's a spot for you.
Skill level does not matter. Showing up and wanting to improve does.

benefits.title: Matched competition
benefits.body: Captains draft balanced rosters so you're paired against opponents at your tier. Every week you get a competitive best-of-three that actually feels fair.

benefits.title: Captains & coaches
benefits.body: Your captains and coaches are helpful people from the community — from seasoned veterans to semi-pros — who draft the team, share strategy, and help you improve.

benefits.title: A team behind you
benefits.body: Private team Discord channels for strategy talk, replay reviews, and camaraderie. You're never grinding alone — you've got a squad.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.body: Apply to join the season through the Gym Discord. Everyone is welcome — skill level does not matter.

steps.title: Get drafted
steps.body: Captains pick their rosters, building teams of players at a similar level.

steps.title: Train with your team
steps.body: Practice, review replays, and prep with your captain and teammates before the season starts.

steps.title: Play your weekly match
steps.body: Each week your team faces another team in a series of solo best-of-three matches.

steps.title: Earn points
steps.body: Results feed the standings — 4 points for a 2–0, 3 for a 2–1, and 1 even for a 1–2 loss.

steps.title: Improve — win or lose
steps.body: Every game gives you replays to study and teammates to learn from. Getting better is the whole point.

children.text: A season runs roughly six weeks, with a break of a few months between cycles. Between seasons the Gym Discord keeps going — volunteer coaching, practice, and a community of Warcraft III players to game with while you wait for the next draft.
